test(keepalive-r2 merge): the decoder binding test (6d85ce2's) with [2b] -- the logon-screen local selection is the bound PC's alone

The merge commit 8731255 left this file out (6d85ce2 adds it; CMake already builds it) -- it comes here, as 6d85ce2
has it plus one case: a stale PC cannot turn the bound PC's armed selection local, reads nothing of its binding, its
commit is Abandoned and records nothing, its refusal refuses nothing; the bound PC commits its own (with its
generation); a PC never bound selects nothing. 17/17; the owner check removed from BeginLocalSelectionForAs -> 2 FAIL.
